name: a11y-warden
description: WCAG 2.2 accessibility audit of static HTML for CI: alt text, form labels, button/link names, inline colour contrast, lang, title, landmarks, ARIA roles/references, aria-hidden focus traps, tabindex, iframe titles, zoom and autoplay, with a baseline file. SARIF, allowlist with expiry, GitHub Action. Zero deps.
author: Louis Wright <hello@louiswright.co.uk> (https://github.com/MrLouisWright)
